mapper.select: SELECT id FROM import_batch WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM detection_batch WHERE batch_id = #{id}

SELECT id, client_ip_hash, client_ip_mask, log_time, method, path, query_string, status_code, user_agent, raw_line_masked FROM log_entry WHERE batch_id = #{id} AND parse_status = 'SUCCESS' ORDER BY client_ip_hash, log_time, id
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO rule_definition (rule_code, rule_name, category, default_severity, description) VALUES (#{code}, #{code}, 'DETECTION', 'HIGH', '')
INSERT INTO event (client_ip_hash, client_ip_mask, window_start, window_end, risk_score, severity, status) VALUES (#{ipHash}, #{ipMask}, #{windowStart}, #{windowEnd}, #{risk}, #{severity}, 'NEW')
INSERT INTO rule_hit (log_entry_id, rule_code, matched_field, evidence_snippet, severity, hit_time) VALUES (#{logId}, #{rule}, #{field}, #{evidence}, #{severity}, #{time})
INSERT INTO event_evidence (event_id, rule_hit_id, is_primary) VALUES (#{row.eventId}, #{row.hitId}, #{row.primary})
mapper.sql: SELECT e.id, e.client_ip_mask, e.window_start, e.window_end, e.risk_score, e.severity, e.status, COUNT(rh.id) hit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT rh.log_entry_id) log_count, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT rh.rule_code ORDER BY rh.rule_code SEPARATOR ',') rule_codes FROM event e JOIN event_evidence ee ON ee.event_id=e.id JOIN rule_hit rh ON rh.id=ee.rule_hit_id
GROUP BY e.id, e.client_ip_mask, e.window_start, e.window_end, e.risk_score, e.severity, e.status
mapper.select: WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM event_evidence filter_ee JOIN rule_hit filter_rh ON filter_rh.id=filter_ee.rule_hit_id JOIN log_entry filter_l ON filter_l.id=filter_rh.log_entry_id WHERE filter_ee.event_id=e.id AND filter_l.batch_id=#{batchId}) ORDER BY e.id DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT l.id, rh.rule_code, rh.matched_field, rh.evidence_snippet, rh.severity, l.log_time, l.raw_line_masked FROM event_evidence ee JOIN rule_hit rh ON rh.id=ee.rule_hit_id JOIN log_entry l ON l.id=rh.log_entry_id WHERE ee.event_id=#{id} ORDER BY l.log_time, l.id, rh.rule_code
